facts.business: Turtlemint is an advisor-led, technology-enabled insurance distribution platform that empowers community-based financial advisors (PoSPs) to sell insurance and investment products, with deep reach in Tier 2, Tier 3, and rural India (B30+ markets).

guidance_or_targets.statement: Continue to deepen penetration and scale insurance distribution in B30+ markets through expanding Digital Partner network
Introducing new insurance products and adding other financial products to become one stop shop for all financial needs of customers
Continue to leverage technology and AI to drive scalable growth and improve operational efficiency
Invest into branding efforts across product lines

key_risks: Environmental, social and governance related risks
facts.related_party_note: Investments in subsidiaries: Turtlemint Mutual Funds Distributors Private Limited (INR 95.10 Mn) and Turtlemint Insurance Broking Services Private Limited (INR 1,799.05 Mn). Deemed equity at cost on account of ESOP scheme (INR 41.92 Mn). Additional investment of INR 90 Mn in Turtlemint Mutual Funds Distributors Private Limited on March 28, 2025. Investment of INR 1,049.05 Mn in Turtlemint Insurance Broking Services Private Limited on May 8, 2024.
